description: The Florida Passport stamp book (55 stamps on 11 region pages: Mile Marker 0, Coral Castle, Weeki Wachee mermaids, a spring swim, Skunk Ape HQ, the time zone line, free OJ at a Welcome Center...). Each stamp is earned only by standing there with the free Headed Back app. Give a position for the closest stamps, a page (road, bay, sarasota, southwest, miami, keys, space, central, nature, northeast, panhandle) or a name. Use it for Florida bucket lists, road-trip stops, or 'what should we not miss'.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

limit.description: How many (default 8, a whole page 10, up to 20)

name.description: Or part of a stamp or place name, e.g. Coral Castle, Ybor

page.description: A region page id or part of its name, e.g. keys, panhandle, Space Coast
